card.name: Scattered connecting words in odd places
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted small words such as 'on', 'occasionally', commas and 'and' in unrelated text, mostly in web boilerplate.

modes.label: Man-page footer
modes.description: The word 'on' in a 'Generated by dwww version ... on' footer line.
modes.example: MAILADDR(7) Generated by dwww version 1.11.3<< on>> Mon May 20 14

modes.label: Stray connectors
modes.description: A comma or 'and' inside a list or name in ordinary prose.
modes.example: the State Department’s coordinator for the Organization for Security<< and>> Cooperation in Europe

card.plain: It reacts to a mix of small linking words with no common theme, so it is hard to describe.
